title: NOV-B1 commit #4: V5 founder-reversion protocol (before the first V5 call)
founder_rule: leader clustering (>= 0.95) in call order per arm-seed over valid offspring among calls 1..C_s; founder = new leader with F below every prompt parent; first 40 pooled by (round, arm order T1.0,T1.6,DTB,RPB,IDEA, call_id, seed)
birth_rule: completion positions inside the kept body where the realised token != argmax and top-20 entropy >= the founder's own 90th percentile; first <= 3
control_rule: same number of positions drawn uniformly (rng [20261031, founder]) from the other non-argmax body positions
continuation: prompt + completion[:p] + argmax token; n = 20 at T 1.0, top_p 1, max_tokens 512 - p - 1, same stops, seed = hash(20261031, founder, p)
reversion: continuation's P1 vector agrees >= 0.95 with either prompt parent; invalid continuations counted separately
reports: per-position reversion rates; per-founder max birth vs control (two-sided sign test); share of founders with a birth position whose reversion >= 0.5, by arm
